crossRefs.note: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it…
But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints…
Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
On the first day of every week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you…
They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment…

translations.web: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;
translations.bsb: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
translations.kjv: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
translations.asv: Now after some years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings:
